This is my current two-page CV, oriented toward **systems modelling for climate adaptation, climate risk, and environmental data science**.

## Current engagement

**Climate Data Consultant (part-time), Khushi Baby · Sep 2026–Jan 2027**

Working on environmental-data methodology for the Climate Health Vulnerability Index (CHVI), including standardising environmental variables and assessing the trade-offs associated with different spatio-temporal aggregation scales.

## Research profile

My current work spans climate-risk measurement, heat stress, high-resolution reanalysis data, spatio-temporal modelling, and the methodological choices that connect quantitative analysis to policy. My broader direction is toward **normatively grounded systems and quantitative modelling for climate adaptation and mitigation planning**.

Current and recent work includes:

- [**Mind the (Jensen) Gap**](/projects/jensen-gap/) — nonlinear aggregation, threshold exceedances, and climate-health measurement.
- [**Heat-stress metrics and the timing of peak season in India**](/projects/wbgt-utci/) — metric-dependent timing of seasonal heat risk.
- [**Heat-wave criteria through uncompensable heat strain**](/projects/partitional-calorimetry/) — physiological heat-risk modelling.
- [**Changing temporal organisation of heat events**](/projects/heat-event-timing/) — onset, duration, persistence, and recovery.
- [**Road-network criticality and access to healthcare**](/projects/road-network-criticality/) — graph and simulation methods for infrastructure vulnerability.
- [**Agent-based models of inequality, segregation, and mobility**](/projects/agent-based-inequality/) — exploratory complex-systems modelling.

## Technical focus

Python is my primary research language. My work uses statistical and spatial modelling, NetworkX and agent-based approaches, ERA5/ERA5-Land/HadISD data, QGIS and geospatial tooling, NetCDF/Zarr, and parallel/chunked workflows for large climate datasets.
